[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to keep the writing group productive and motivated, including:  
1. Set clear goals and expectations  
2. Create a schedule and stick to it  
3. Establish a format for sharing work

5. Respect each other's time  
6. Encourage accountability  
7. Mix it up  
8. Celebrate milestones  
9. Communicate openly  
10. Be flexible
